meta.name: The Information War
meta.note: Single source of truth for the event. The server, the docs generator and the spreadsheet all read this file. Lock it (set lockedAt) before round 1; never edit it during the event.

stocks.name: Novatex Devices
stocks.description: Smartphones, wearables and home devices. Relies on imported components; launches a flagship handset this season.
stocks.links: Buys components from Forgeline. Sensitive to interest rates (growth stock).

profile.overview: Valdoria's best-known consumer electronics brand. Designs in-house and assembles locally, but imports most chips and displays. The new flagship handset launches this season.
watch: Launch demand compared with previous handsets
Prices and availability of imported components
Interest rates: much of its value rests on future growth

stocks.name: Harbourline Financial Group
stocks.description: Valdoria's third-largest bank: retail deposits, business lending and a trading desk.
stocks.links: Earns more when interest rates rise. Lends to Solaris Ridge and Tidewell.

profile.revenueMix: Retail banking 45% · Business lending 35% · Markets & trading 20%
profile.overview: Third-largest bank in Valdoria. Lends to households and mid-sized companies, including renewables developers and logistics firms. Its markets division has grown quickly in recent years.
watch: Central bank interest-rate decisions
Loan quality among its business borrowers
Capital buffers and regulator stress tests

stocks.name: Petralis Energy
stocks.description: Oil and gas producer with offshore fields and a fuel distribution arm.
stocks.links: Competes with renewables for energy policy. Exports priced in foreign currency.

profile.overview: Produces oil and gas from three offshore fields, the oldest of which is slowly declining, and runs a national chain of fuel depots. Has applied for new offshore licences.
watch: Timing of the energy ministry's licence decisions
Government energy policy, fossil fuels versus renewables
World oil prices and the exchange rate

stocks.name: Calvera Health
stocks.description: Pharmaceutical developer. Its lead drug VX-7 (arthritis) is in late-stage trials.
stocks.links: Value depends heavily on VX-7 regulatory outcome and competitors.

profile.revenueMix: Generic medicines 70% · Licensing 30% (VX-7 not yet on sale)
profile.overview: Mid-sized drug developer. Existing generic medicines fund its research. VX-7, an arthritis treatment in late-stage trials, would be its first major branded drug.
watch: VX-7 trial data and the regulator's decision
How many patients VX-7 could eventually reach
Other arthritis treatments in development

stocks.name: Marlowe & Kent
stocks.description: Department stores and online retail. Holiday season is half of annual profit.
stocks.links: Imports most holiday stock through the Port of Ashmouth. Sensitive to consumer spending.

profile.overview: Valdoria's largest department-store chain, with 48 stores and a growing online business. About half of each year's profit is made in the holiday season.
watch: Consumer confidence and household spending
Holiday stock arriving on time through the Port of Ashmouth
Online growth versus the cost of running stores

stocks.name: Forgeline Industries
stocks.description: Precision components: electronics parts, gearboxes and industrial bearings.
stocks.links: Supplies Novatex and the wind-turbine industry. Depends on imported bearings.

profile.revenueMix: Electronics parts 40% · Wind-turbine gearboxes 35% · Industrial bearings 25%
profile.overview: Precision engineering group. Its two largest customers are Novatex and the wind-power industry, and it imports specialist steel for its bearings.
watch: Order books at Novatex and wind-farm builders
Supply of imported bearings and steel
Renewable energy subsidy policy

stocks.name: Tidewell Logistics
stocks.description: Container terminals, trucking and Valdoria's only inland rail-freight corridor.
stocks.links: Fuel is a major cost. Moves goods for Marlowe & Kent and Greenfield.

profile.overview: Runs container terminals at the Port of Ashmouth, a national trucking fleet and the country's only inland rail-freight corridor. Fuel is its largest operating cost.
watch: Fuel prices
Trade volumes through the Port of Ashmouth
Freight rates across port, road and rail

stocks.name: Arcwave Communications
stocks.description: Mobile and broadband network operator with high debt from its 5G build-out.
stocks.links: Debt-heavy, so sensitive to interest rates. Bidding in the 6G spectrum auction.

profile.overview: Valdoria's second-largest network operator. Borrowed heavily to build its 5G network and is now bidding in the 6G spectrum auction.
watch: The final price of 6G spectrum
Interest rates and refinancing of its debt
Subscriber growth and pricing

stocks.name: Greenfield Harvest Foods
stocks.description: Grain, dairy and packaged foods. Exports a large share of its output.
stocks.links: Exports via the Port of Ashmouth. Harvest yields drive annual results.

profile.overview: Farming and food group with its own farms, dairies and packaging plants. Exports a large share of what it produces through the Port of Ashmouth.
watch: Harvest yields and the weather
Export routes and shipping costs
Food prices in export markets

stocks.name: Solaris Ridge Renewables
stocks.description: Builds and operates solar and wind farms financed with long-term borrowing.
stocks.links: Depends on government subsidy policy and interest rates. Buys gearboxes from Forgeline.

profile.overview: Builds and runs solar and wind farms, financed with long-term borrowing. Part of its income comes from government subsidy contracts. Buys its gearboxes from Forgeline.
watch: Parliament's renewable energy subsidy plans
Interest rates
Construction costs for new farms

rounds.title: Initial Positions
rounds.purpose: Teach the market and establish opening beliefs. Calm round, no shock.
rounds.hiddenState: Economy steady. Small, mostly positive drifts. Petralis licence decision quietly delayed.

news.headline: Valdoria GDP grows 1.8%, in line with forecasts
news.body: The Statistics Office reports steady third-quarter growth. Consumer confidence is unchanged. Novatex confirms its flagship handset launches next month.

news.headline: Energy ministry to rule on new offshore licences 'in due course'
news.body: Petralis Energy is among the applicants. No date has been set.

signals.text: Novatex handset pre-orders are tracking ahead of last year's launch.
signals.truth: True. Small positive effect this round.

signals.text: Petralis is about to be awarded a large new offshore licence.
signals.truth: False. The decision was delayed indefinitely.

signals.text: Solaris Ridge's quarterly installations came in slightly above plan.
signals.truth: True. Small positive effect.

research.title: Petralis licence: second source
research.result: A ministry official says no licence decisions will be made this quarter.

rounds.title: Conflicting Signals
rounds.purpose: Test trust in private information versus public evidence. Signals about Novatex conflict.
rounds.hiddenState: Novatex margin compression is structural (component costs), outweighing strong unit sales. Calvera interim data genuinely strong.

news.headline: Novatex: revenue up 14%, gross margin falls from 41% to 36%
news.body: Management calls the margin decline 'temporary' but gives no timetable.

news.headline: Calvera publishes interim VX-7 trial data
news.body: The arthritis drug shows a 'statistically significant' improvement. Full data and a regulatory decision are expected later this season.

signals.text: Retail channel checks: stores are reordering Novatex devices; demand is strong.
signals.truth: Demand really is strong, but margins matter more to value. Stock fell.

signals.text: Detailed VX-7 tables show the effect size is larger than the headline suggests.
signals.truth: True.

signals.text: Novatex's margin decline will continue into next year as component contracts reprice.
signals.truth: True. The margin issue is structural.

research.title: Novatex margin breakdown
research.result: Component costs rose 9% and are locked in by annual contracts. No margin recovery is guided for next quarter.

rounds.title: Crowd Behaviour
rounds.purpose: Make anonymous order flow strategically relevant. Teams decide whether flow is information or noise.
rounds.hiddenState: Subsidy hearings are genuinely positive for renewables and their suppliers. Spectrum auction will be expensive for Arcwave.

news.headline: Parliament opens hearings on the Renewable Infrastructure Subsidy Act
news.body: A vote is expected later this season. Energy producers warn of higher carbon costs.

news.headline: Telecom regulator opens consultation on the 6G spectrum auction
news.body: Reserve prices have not been published.

forecast.question: Will SLRD's reference value finish this round higher or lower than it started?

signals.text: A large institutional fund is quietly accumulating renewable-infrastructure stocks.
signals.truth: True, and the fundamentals supported it.

signals.text: Arcwave expects to win 6G spectrum cheaply because few rivals will bid.
signals.truth: False. Reserve prices will be high.

signals.text: Forgeline has quietly signed a supply deal for wind-turbine gearboxes.
signals.truth: True. Second-order beneficiary of the subsidy story.

research.title: 6G auction reserve prices
research.result: Draft documents suggest reserve prices roughly double the last auction.

rounds.title: Supply-Chain Discovery
rounds.purpose: Test second-order reasoning. One disruption helps one company and hurts others.
rounds.hiddenState: Port strike hurts importers and exporters; Tidewell's inland rail corridor earns emergency surcharges and is a net winner.

news.headline: Dockworkers' strike shuts the Port of Ashmouth
news.body: Valdoria's largest container port is expected to remain closed for about ten days. Ships are queuing offshore.

signals.text: Tidewell's rail-freight corridor is fully booked at emergency rates for the next month.
signals.truth: True. Tidewell is a net winner from the strike.

signals.text: Marlowe & Kent brought its holiday stock in early this year, before the strike.
signals.truth: False. Most holiday stock is stuck on ships at Ashmouth.

signals.text: Forgeline's critical imported bearings are sitting in containers at Ashmouth.
signals.truth: True. Production delays.

research.title: Who depends on Ashmouth?
research.result: Marlowe & Kent: ~70% of holiday imports. Greenfield: ~40% of exports. Forgeline: key bearings. Tidewell runs the only inland rail alternative.

rounds.title: Macroeconomic Shift
rounds.purpose: Introduce cross-stock relationships. A rate shock moves sectors in different directions.
rounds.hiddenState: Rate hike: banks win; leveraged and growth companies lose; defensives hold up.

news.headline: Central Bank surprises with a 0.75-point rate rise
news.body: The Bank signals further increases to fight inflation. The Valdorian crown strengthens sharply against major currencies.

signals.text: Harbourline's treasury desk expects its lending margin to widen sharply after the hike.
signals.truth: True.

signals.text: Arcwave refinanced all of its debt at fixed rates, so rate rises won't hurt it.
signals.truth: Outdated. Only half was refinanced; the rest floats.

signals.text: Solaris Ridge is about to announce a state-guaranteed loan that shields it from rate rises.
signals.truth: False. Talks collapsed.

research.title: Debt and rate-sensitivity table
research.result: Floating-rate debt as share of total: Solaris Ridge 65%, Arcwave 50%, Tidewell 30%, Novatex 10%. Harbourline earns more on floating-rate loans.

rounds.title: Rumour and Verification
rounds.purpose: Make research credits valuable. Two rumours: one partly true, one false.
rounds.hiddenState: VX-7 approval comes with a restricted label (smaller market than hoped). Arcwave takeover is false. Port strike settles.

news.headline: Reports: Calvera's VX-7 approval 'imminent'
news.body: Unconfirmed reports say the regulator will approve the arthritis drug this week.

news.headline: Blog claims Arcwave is a takeover target
news.body: A financial blog says a foreign operator is preparing a bid. Arcwave declined to comment.

forecast.question: Will CLVH's reference value finish this round higher or lower than it started?

signals.text: A regulator staffer says VX-7 approval is 'a formality'.
signals.truth: Approval is real, but the label is restricted to severe cases. Gain smaller than the hype.

signals.text: Arcwave's board has hired investment bankers.
signals.truth: True fact, wrong meaning: the bankers are arranging a bond issue, not a sale.

signals.text: The Ashmouth strike was settled overnight; the port reopens tomorrow.
signals.truth: True. Tidewell's surcharges end; importers and exporters recover.

research.title: Verify the VX-7 approval rumour
research.result: Second source: approval is expected, but the label will likely be restricted to severe cases (about a third of the target market).

research.title: Verify the Arcwave takeover rumour
research.result: Second source: the banker mandate is for a bond refinancing. No bidder has been identified.

research.title: Port of Ashmouth status
research.result: Union and port authority have a draft agreement; vote scheduled tonight.

rounds.title: Liquidity Shock
rounds.purpose: Test execution and risk management. Market-maker capacity drops, spreads widen (pre-announced in the rulebook).
rounds.hiddenState: Harbourline's hedge-fund exposure is larger than admitted. Broad risk-off move.

news.headline: Hedge fund Corvane Capital collapses
news.body: Harbourline Financial confirms 'manageable' exposure. Several lenders are reviewing positions.

news.headline: Exchange notice: reduced liquidity this round
news.body: As set out in the rulebook, market-maker spreads are wider and depth is thinner in all stocks for Round 7.

signals.text: Harbourline's Corvane exposure is about three times the amount it has disclosed.
signals.truth: True.

signals.text: Bargain hunters are lining up for Harbourline; the sell-off is overdone.
signals.truth: False. Losses were larger than disclosed.

signals.text: Petralis has hedged most of next year's output at today's high prices.
signals.truth: True. Small positive effect; defensive in a risk-off market.

research.title: Independent Harbourline exposure estimate
research.result: Exposure is roughly 4% of the bank's equity: painful, not fatal. Dividend at risk.

rounds.title: The Narrative Breaks
rounds.purpose: Challenge previously successful assumptions. The renewables and Calvera stories reverse.
rounds.hiddenState: Subsidy act withdrawn for good; energy policy swings back to fossil fuels. A rival drug beats VX-7. Novatex launch succeeds.

news.headline: Budget crisis: government withdraws the Renewable Subsidy Act
news.body: The Treasury announces a full review of energy policy.

news.headline: Ostrava Pharma launches rival arthritis drug
news.body: Its trial results beat VX-7 and it will be sold at a lower price.

signals.text: Ministry insiders say the subsidy withdrawal is temporary; the act returns within weeks.
signals.truth: False. No reintroduction before the next election.

signals.text: Novatex's new handset sold out in its first weekend.
signals.truth: True.

signals.text: Ostrava's drug faces manufacturing problems that will limit supply for a year.
signals.truth: Outdated. The problems were fixed last month.

research.title: Will the subsidy act return?
research.result: Treasury sources: no reintroduction before the next election.

research.title: Ostrava manufacturing check
research.result: Ostrava's plant passed regulatory inspection last month. Supply constraints are resolved.

rounds.title: Final Intelligence
rounds.purpose: Weigh new evidence against existing positions. Balanced final clues; one points to next round.
rounds.hiddenState: Inflation cooling: rate-sensitive stocks rebound, banks give back gains. Arcwave deal is genuinely valuable.

news.headline: Inflation falls faster than expected
news.body: Economists now expect the Central Bank to pause rate rises.

news.headline: Arcwave signs network-sharing deal with a regional operator

forecast.question: Will ARCM's reference value finish this round higher or lower than it started?

signals.text: Arcwave's network-sharing deal cuts its capital spending by about a quarter.
signals.truth: True.

signals.text: Greenfield's harvest yields hit a record; it reports full-year results next round.
signals.truth: True. The payoff arrives in Round 10, not Round 9.

signals.text: Harbourline will announce a large special dividend at year-end.
signals.truth: False. The dividend is suspended in Round 10.

research.title: Extra macro indicator: core inflation
research.result: Core inflation 2.1%, down from 3.4% two months ago.

rounds.title: The Endgame
rounds.purpose: Close cleanly. Same rules and limits; no special final mechanic.
rounds.hiddenState: Full-year results: consumer recovery, record harvest, Harbourline suspends dividend, freight normalises.

news.headline: Results day: all ten companies report full-year numbers
news.body: Headline: Valdoria avoids recession as consumer spending recovers. This is the final trading round.

signals.text: Marlowe & Kent's holiday sales are running 9% above last year.
signals.truth: True.

signals.text: Tidewell will announce a large share buyback with its results.
signals.truth: False. Freight volumes normalise and no buyback is announced.

signals.text: Calvera's full-year results include a one-off licensing gain.
signals.truth: True. Modest positive effect.

research.title: Harbourline dividend check
research.result: Board minutes show the dividend is 'under review' because of Corvane losses.
